canonicalSources.role: additional evidence for existing complex profiles

verification.method: Pull-request exporter plus independent regenerated-release validator plus full application/source/test/build suite
verification.details: The reviewed catalog materialized 61 unique profiles, 84 unique evidence sources, and 40 profile-linked media records. Export validation, source/acquisition/transfer validation, TypeScript checks, regression tests, crop geometry validation, and production build all passed.

verification.method: Main-branch read-back after merge and generated-data commit
verification.details: Will verify the committed main index, standalone profile count, evidence-source count, media count, representative corrected profiles, and blocked training gate.

verification.method: Independent clean-room PR against the merged generated release
verification.details: Will rerun regenerated release validation and the full application/source/test/build suite without merging the verification marker.

accuracyCorrections: Machine exporter reads the reviewed application catalog rather than bypassing catalog-level source corrections and evidence augmentations.
Diagnostic index is regenerated from the exact same catalog instead of being manually maintained.
Rice root aphid and Septoria cannabicola source metadata are normalized before both app use and export.
Downy mildew is represented consistently as an oomycete; root-knot nematodes are represented as nematodes.
Molybdenum low-status is an explicit analytical abstention class rather than a fabricated visual deficiency phenotype.
Fusarium foliar/flower/head blight remains separate from Fusarium root/crown disease.
Pythium, Fusarium, and Sclerotinia receive newer species-level evidence without creating visually unjustified species classifiers.
Issue JSON Schema media field matches structured MediaRecord objects used by the application and release.
Exporter and release-validator workflows regenerate current catalog output before validation and watch all src/data modules.
